verdict.rationale: Datalab ships agent processors (run-document-agent), so letting those agents use tools from MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents connecting or registering external MCP servers. The llms.txt file, CLI, SDK and webhooks are unrelated capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
